charts.title: TOI-1782 b: orbits around TOI-1782
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-1782's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-1782 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Crossfield et al. 2025 (2025AJ....169...89C), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname CROSSFIELD_ET_AL_2025): P 1.829024227 d

charts.title: TOI-1782 b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-1782 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (53, 60, 75) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 160045097, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 6-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 6-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
